name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello and welcome to 6 Minute English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I'm Dan and joining me today is Catherine.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hey Catherine.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hey Dan.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So Catherine, do you prefer a brew or a cup of joe in the morning?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, if you are referring to whether I prefer a cup of tea, which we sometimes call ‘a

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: brew’, or a cup of coffee, sometimes called ‘a cup of joe’, I prefer my coffee in

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: the morning.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I only drink coffee when I really need to wake up quickly.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And, why are you asking, Dan?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Because it’s part of this 6 Minute English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Coffee.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I see.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So how do you take it then, Dan?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, I’m an instant coffee kind of guy.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I like mine with a dash of milk.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: How about you?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A dash of something is a small amount of something, especially liquid.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Personally, I prefer freshly-ground coffee beans, and I like my coffee dark and strong

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: - preferably Colombian or maybe Brazilian.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Wow.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A coffee aficionado, eh?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: An aficionado is a person who’s very enthusiastic about, or interested in, a particular subject.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, let me test your knowledge with this week’s quiz question.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The specialty coffee, Kopi luwak, is made from coffee beans which have already passed

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: through an animal’s digestive system.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But which animal?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a) an elephant

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: b) a cat

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: c) a weasel

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m always going to answer b) a cat.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Did you say this coffee actually goes through the animal?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: As in, it eats it and then it comes out the other end, and that’s what we use for the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: coffee?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, yes.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It is actually one of the most expensive coffees in the world.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Anyway, we’ll find out if you’re right or not later on.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So, talking of expensive, do you tend to pay more for your coffee or are you happy with

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: the cheap as chips stuff?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Cheap as chips means very cheap.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And personally, I do actually like a quality product, and I am willing to pay a bit more

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: for it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Would you be willing to pay even more than you already do if it meant that the farmer

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: who grew the beans was getting a fairer price?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I would because I think that that sort of thing is important.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And you aren’t alone.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There is a growing trend among many Western customers of artisan cafes to be willing to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: pay more for ethically produced coffee.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Ethical means morally right.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So, Dan, why is this trend happening at the moment?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, it’s probably been going on for a while, but a new report from the UN’s World

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Intellectual Property Organisation has observed the effect that smarter processing, branding

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and marketing has had on the farmers and their communities.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And because of this, coffee drinkers are better able to choose ethically produced coffee that

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: puts more money in the hands of the farmers.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But, Dan, do the farmers actually see any of this money?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, it’s complicated.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The price of the coffee is relatively cheap until it’s been roasted – or cooked in

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: an oven.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: As a result, roasters take most of the profits.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But there is still a difference.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’ll let Johnathan Josephs, a business reporter for the BBC News explain.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Jonathan Josephs , Business reporter, BBC News

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: For a pound of coffee beans that end up in the instants (section) sold in supermarkets,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: the roaster can get over $4.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But the export price is just $1.45.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The farmer gets most of that.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But when the new wave of socially-aware customer pays a premium for higher standards, the roaster

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: can get $17.45, but the export price also rises to $5.14.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A premium is an amount that’s more than usual.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So the farmer makes three-and-a-half times as much money.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Which means a better quality of life for the farmer, their family and their community.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That’s good news!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I will definitely look for the ethically produced coffee from now on.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: As long as, Dan, it doesn’t come out of some animal!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yes, actually that reminds me.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Our quiz question.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I asked you which animal the speciality coffee Kopi luwak comes from.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a) an elephant

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: b) a cat

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: c) a weasel

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I said a cat.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And you are wrong I’m afraid.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Kopi luwak comes from a type of weasel.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m kind of relieved about that.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Let’s try not to think about it, and have a look at the vocabulary instead.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So, first we had dash.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A dash of something is a small amount of something, usually a liquid.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Where might we talk about a dash of something, Dan?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, I like my tea with a dash of milk.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: My gin with a dash of tonic, and my soup with a dash of salt.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Then we had aficionado.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: An aficionado is someone who is very interested or enthusiastic about a subject.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What are you an aficionado of?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m working on becoming a bit of an accordion aficionado actually, Dan.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Wow, cool!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yeah!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: After that, we had as cheap as chips.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Is something as cheap as chips?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Then it is very cheap indeed.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Like my shoes!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I bought them at a market for next to nothing.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: They were as cheap as chips.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Then we had ethical.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Something which is ethical is morally right.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Do you consider yourself to be an ethical person, Catherine?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, I try, Dan.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I don’t always get it right, but I do attempt to be.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: After that we heard roasted.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Roasted means cooked in an oven.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Like our coffee beans!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And of course our very famous English roast.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Finally, we had a premium.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If you pay a premium, you pay more than usual - usually for a better quality or service.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Can you think of an example?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If you’re going to the cinema, you might pay a premium to get more comfortable seats.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And that’s the end of this 6 Minute English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Don’t forget to check out our YouTube, Facebook, Twitter and Instagram pages, and we’ll see

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: you next time.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Goodbye.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: This is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I’m Sam.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Have you always wanted to learn to dance the tango, do a magic trick, or skydive?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If so, perhaps you need a bucket list – a list of all the things you want to do before

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: you die – that’s the topic of our programme.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bucket lists have been called ‘the greatest hits of your life’ and have helped some

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: people overcome anxiety and fear of following their dreams.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But they’ve also been accused of limiting the imagination by encouraging people to follow

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: someone else’s idea of the perfect life.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So, what would be on your bucket list, Neil?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Are you a skydiving kind of person?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Not really!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bungee-jumping maybe - as long as someone checked the elastic rope!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: How about you?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: One thing I’ve always wanted to do is swim with dolphins.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, you’re not alone there, Sam, because swimming with dolphins is one of the most

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: commonly included personal goals on bucket lists.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But which of the following things do you think tops the list?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That’s my quiz question for today.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Is it:

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a) swimming with dolphins

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: b) getting a tattoo, or

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: c) seeing the northern lights

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’ll go for a) swimming with dolphins – one, because it’s something I really want to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: do and two, because I’ve heard so many stories about how it improves your mental health.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, that was certainly true in the case of blogger Annette White.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: She listed hundreds of things she wanted to accomplish - from learning Spanish to hanging

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: out with penguins in Antarctica - as a way of improving her psychological wellbeing.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Here she is talking to Claudia Hammond for BBC Radio 4’s programme All in the Mind:

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You said that you started all this to try to help you overcome your anxiety – has

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: it done that?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It definitely has and I feel that the reason is because that promise to live my bucket

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: list really continuously pushes the comfort zone to its limits and beyond it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So every time I can have a chance to step out of my comfort zone, a little piece of

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: that fear of the unknown is removed and replaced with a little piece of empowerment, and by

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: continuously doing that, the size of my fear bubble has gotten smaller.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Annette feels that choosing adventurous goals for her bucket list helps her step outside

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: her comfort zone – the situations where she feels safe and comfortable but where her

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: ability and determination are not really being tested.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Moving out of her comfort zone has helped Annette replace her feelings of fear with

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: feelings of empowerment – the process of becoming stronger and more confident, especially

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: in controlling her life.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, that all sounds pretty good to me.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But not everyone is convinced that bucket lists can really help people like Annette

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: in the long run.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Here’s clinical psychologist Linda Blair to explain why:

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m not really in favour of bucket lists.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There are a couple of reasons.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Most of all, you’re kind of fooling yourself with a bucket list.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We fear death, more than I think we fear anything else in our existence, because we can’t

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: predict it, and because we don’t know what it’s like because nobody comes back and

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: tells us.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And when you create a bucket list – something to do before you ‘kick the bucket’,the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: idea that you’re giving yourself is that you can somehow control when and what death

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: is going to be all about.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We only make sense of our lives at the end of it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A bucket list takes you away from the chance to be spontaneous and I think it’s so delicious

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: to be able to say, ‘that’s an opportunity?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: – oh, I’ll do that!’

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Linda thinks some people use bucket lists as a coping strategy to try to control something

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: uncontrollable – death.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In this way they are fooling - or deceiving - themselves - trying to make themselves believe

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: something they know is not really true.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And by having a checklist of adventures to tick off before they die, people might lose

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: the chance to be spontaneous – to act in a natural and impulsive way without planning.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Linda also uses an unusual expression which gave ‘bucket list’ its name in the first

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: place.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A bucket list is all the things you want to do before you ‘kick the bucket’ – an

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: informal way of saying, ‘die’.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: ‘Kick the bucket’ is an old English expression that was even used by Shakespeare.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It refers to kicking the bucket away from under the feet of a hanging man, leaving him

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: to drop to his death.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, anyway, I hope I don’t kick the bucket before I’ve had a chance to tell you the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: correct answer to today’s quiz.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Remember, I asked you which personal goal was most often included in bucket lists?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I said, a) swimming with dolphins

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But the actual answer was c) seeing the northern lights

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, maybe we could combine the two in a single trip…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And then get a tattoo!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That would be spontaneous!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Today, we’ve been discussing bucket lists – lists of all the things you want to do

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: before you ‘kick the bucket’ – an informal way of saying ‘die’.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bucket lists can be a great way to feel empowered – stronger and more in control of your life,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: because they take you out of your comfort zone – comfortable situations which are

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: safe but not challenging.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But others think you’re fooling – or deceiving yourself – if you think bucket lists can

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: really help you control your life.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In fact, they might even make you less spontaneous – less able to act in natural, sudden and

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: impulsive ways.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That’s all from us for now.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Why not go and make some plans for all the things you’d like to do in your life?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And start having adventures before we see you next time here at 6 Minute English from

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: BBC Learning English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Goodbye.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello, and welcome to 6 Minute English, I'm Neil and joining me today is Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So Rob, what's the most dangerous thing you've ever chosen to do?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Mmm.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Tricky question.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I've done many risky things, but probably the most risky thing is bungee jumping in

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: New Zealand.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Oh wow, bungee jumping.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You'd never catch me doing that.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Did you enjoy it?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Not really, no.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I won't do it again!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, well today our topic is risk and how different people react to different levels of risk in

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: different ways.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: For example, would you be happy to be in a driverless car?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Absolutely not!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: No, I don't trust anybody's driving - even a computer.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So no, I wouldn't go in a driverless car.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, I won't offer you a lift!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Driverless cars are the topic of today's quiz.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The question is: When was the first driverless car demonstrated on a public road?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Was it:

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I think they are quite modern, so I'm going to say 1970s.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, well we'll find out if you're right at the end of the programme.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Joe Kable is an Associate Professor of Psychology at the University of Pennsylvania.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In a recent BBC science programme, All in the Mind, he talked about the psychology of

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: risk and whether there was anything physically in our brains that could predict how much

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: risk we are prepared to accept.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Here he is, first talking about a number of different ways people see risk.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: How many different types does he describe?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Some people are quite risk-averse and really don't want to take any decisions where there's

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: risk involved at all, whereas others are fairly risk-tolerant and in some cases even risk-seeking

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: so they seek out decisions that have an aspect of risk to them.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: How many different types of people did he mention, when it comes to attitudes to risk?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, there were three.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The first group was those who are risk-averse.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If you are averse to something, you are against it, you don't like it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So risk-averse people don't like to take risks.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The second group are those who are risk-tolerant.If you are tolerant of something, you accept

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: it, you don't mind it, it's not a problem for you.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So someone who is risk-tolerantis not worried by an element of risk in what they choose

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: to do.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The third group he mentioned are those who are risk-seeking.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If you seek something, you actively look for it, you try to find it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So risk seekers are those who enjoy risk and want to take risks in their life.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Associate Professor Kable carried out research on risk-taking and discovered that there were

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: differences in brain structure and the way parts of the brain worked together between

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: those who are risk-averse and those who are risk-tolerant or risk seekers.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So it seems as if this is something that could be measured.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You could put someone in a brain scanner and tell if they like risk or not.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I wonder how useful that would be though – is there any practical application for this knowledge?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Good question and one that was put to Kable.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What area does he say this could be applied to?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Definitely something that I can see coming out of this is using these associations to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: help develop better assessments of who's likely to take risks versus not.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: This is exactly the thing that financial advisors want to assess when you come to them and say

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: 'I want to put my money away for retirement'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Exactly the aspect of your personality that they want to know is what's your tolerance

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: for taking risk?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In which area does he say knowledge of someone's attitude to risk might be useful?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Financial planning.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: He says that financial advisors, who are people that give advice on what to do with our money,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: would find this information very useful.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It would help them to assess what to do with your money, which means it would help them

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: to decide, to make an intelligent decision about your money in certain situations.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: For example, if you are planning for your retirement.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Retirement is the time when are able to or you have to stop working.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: He also used an interesting expression there, to put your money away, which means 'save

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: your money', 'put it somewhere where you can't spend it and where it can grow'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You know I think my financial planner could just ask me about how I feel about risk rather

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: than giving me a brain scan.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I heard brain scans can be risky!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Mmm, not sure that's true but anyway, what is true is the answer to this week's quiz

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: question.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I asked you when the first driverless car was demonstrated on a public road.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The options were a) the 1970s, b) the1950s and c) the 1920s.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What did you say Rob?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I said the 1970s.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And you were wrong, I'm afraid.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Apparently it was the 1920s, so a long time ago.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well done if you got that right.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now before we drive off into the sunset, let's recap today's vocabulary.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yes right, first we had three words describing different attitudes to risk.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There was risk-averse, for people who don't like risk.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: People who don't mind risk are risk-tolerant.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And people who like risk and want risk are risk seekers.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Next we had the verb to assess.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: This means 'to make a judgement or a decision based on information'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A phrase meaning 'to save money' is to put money away.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And finally, we had retirement.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That time of life when you are too old to work anymore or you have enough money that

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: you don't need to work anymore.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Are you looking forward to your retirement Rob?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Cheeky.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I'm neither old enough nor rich enough to even think about that Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Same here.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well that's all from us today, and you don't have to be a risk seeker to find us on Facebook,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Twitter, Instagram and YouTube, and of course on our website bbclearningenglish.com!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Thank you for joining us and goodbye.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello, I'm Rob and welcome to 6 Minute English– the show that brings you an interesting topic

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and authentic listening practice…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: ...and don't forget vocabulary to help you improve your language skills.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I'm Neil by the way and today we're off on an adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But not a very big adventure Neil – it's just a mini or microadventure – but if you

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: have wanderlust – a strong desire to travel – I think it may appeal.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It will appeal to you Rob because you love to travel – haven't you circumnavigated

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: the globe – I mean go all the way round the world?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Almost Neil – but today's mini-adventure doesn't involve travelling too far from home.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We'll explore the topic more in a moment but not before we've set today's quiz question.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So Neil do you know how far it is around the world measured at the equator – in other

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: worlds the circumference?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It is approximately…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, I haven't walked it but I know it's a long way – so I'll go for c) 50,000 km.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I shall keep you in suspense and tell you the answer at the end of the programme.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Our topic for discussion won't be travelling so far – it's about a new trend for small

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: adventures.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Neil What you mean are shorter breaks, closer to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: home.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: They're less expensive of course but also instil a sense of adventure – that's the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: feeling of doing a new, exciting and sometimes dangerous activity.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, adventurer, Alastair Humphreys has coined the phrase 'microadventures' to describe this.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: 'To coin' here means to use a word or phrase that no one has used before.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now he's someone who goes on big trips and expeditions to the four corners of the globe

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and writing books about his adventures.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But he wanted to prove you don't have to go far to find adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Let's hear from him now – speaking on BBC Radio 4's You and Yours programme – about

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: what he did.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: How did he describe his first microadventure?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I'd been doing big adventures for years and I had this hunch that you didn't need to go

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: to the ends of the world to have some sort of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You didn't need to be in beautiful Patagonia to have the spirit of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So I decided to try and prove my theory by doing the most boring, ugly adventure I could

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: think of.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I came up with the idea of walking a lap of the M25 in the snow in January.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And time and again as I walked round the M25 I just kept thinking to myself this experience

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: is exactly the same as the four years I spent cycling round the world.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Smaller, of course, a bit silly, but definitely felt like an adventure And that's when I really

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: started to come up with the idea of microadventures.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So a microadventure is a boring, ugly adventure?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: No Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It may not be glamourous but it is an adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: He walked around the London orbital motorway – called the M25 – to prove his hunch

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: that you don't need to go far to find adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A hunch is an idea you have based on feelings but there's no proof.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well his hunch was right.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But walking alongside a motorway isn't my idea of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It doesn't have to be Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Just getting out on your bike and exploring somewhere in your locality that you haven't

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: visited before is an adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And how about camping?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Ah yes, I do like to camp out – that's a phrasal verb to mean sleep outside in a tent.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You can be so close to nature and breathe in the fresh air.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yep and you don't need to go far for a camping adventure – and being out a night really

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: adds to the sense of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's what Alastair Humphreys believes…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We humans are so boring these days – we so rarely spend time out in the darkness to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: see the stars and to see how the world feels different by night.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I get a little bit nervous still – I still imagine ghosts – but that's part of the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: charm of making a little frisson of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And then in the morning the sun comes up, the birds sing, jump in a river, back on the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: bus, back to your desk for 9.00.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Seeing how the world feels at night is a nice idea.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Getting a bit nervous – anxious maybe – is part of the pleasure or enjoyment – what

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Alastair calls 'charm'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I agree – and he used another word 'frisson' meaning a sudden, strong feeling of excitement,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: or fear.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: My biggest fear would be returning to my desk for 9.00!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But Alastair is right, there is an adventure to be had on your doorstep – that means

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: close to where you live.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But only a small adventure Rob!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Unlike an adventure round the circumference of the Earth.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yes that was my question earlier: how far it is around the world measured at the equator

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: – in other worlds the circumference?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It is approximately…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I said c) 50,000 km.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Sorry Neil – too far.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The Earth's circumference has been calculated to be 40,075km.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: To travel that distance would be a major adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, I think we should remind ourselves of the some of the words and phrases we've discussed

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: today – starting with wanderlust – a strong desire to travel.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Rob has wanderlust, he's never at home!"

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's because I have a sense of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's the feeling of doing a new, exciting and sometimes dangerous activity.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Neil has no sense of adventure because he likes his holidays to be planned out with

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: no surprises!"

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's a little unfair Rob – I just like to be 'holiday happy' – that's a term I've

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: just coined, which means used a word or phrase that no one has used before.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You can also say 'to coin a phrase' after using an expression that is well known and

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: possibly used too much.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Next we heard hunch – that's an idea you have based on feelings but there's no proof.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "I have a hunch Neil wants to go to the pub – he's packing his bag!"

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Your hunch is correct Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But not before we recap our next word charm – that's part of the pleasure or enjoyment

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: of something.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Part of the charm of going to the seaside is eating ice cream and walking down the pier."

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And finally we heard on your doorstep - that means close to where you live.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "There's a pub right on your doorstep, so why don't you make the most of it!"

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I intend to Rob but first let me to remind you that you can learn English with us at

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: bbclearningenglish.com.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's it for today's 6 Minute English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We hope you enjoyed it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye for now.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye.

text: Smaller, of course, a bit silly, but definitely felt like an adventure And that's when I really

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: started to come up with the idea of microadventures.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So a microadventure is a boring, ugly adventure?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: No Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It may not be glamourous but it is an adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: He walked around the London orbital motorway – called the M25 – to prove his hunch

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: that you don't need to go far to find adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A hunch is an idea you have based on feelings but there's no proof.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, his hunch was right.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But walking alongside a motorway isn't my idea of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It doesn't have to be Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Just getting out on your bike and exploring somewhere in your locality that you haven't

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: visited before is an adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And how about camping?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Ah yes, I do like to camp out – that's a phrasal verb to mean sleep outside in a tent.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You can be so close to nature and breathe in the fresh air.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yep and you don't need to go far for a camping adventure – and being out a night really

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: adds to the sense of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's what Alastair Humphreys believes…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We humans are so boring these days – we so rarely spend time out in the darkness to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: see the stars and to see how the world feels different by night.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I get a little bit nervous still – I still imagine ghosts – but that's part of the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: charm of making a little frisson of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And then in the morning the sun comes up, the birds sing, jump in a river, back on the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: bus, back to your desk for 9.00.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Seeing how the world feels at night is a nice idea.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Getting a bit nervous – anxious maybe – is part of the pleasure or enjoyment – what

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Alastair calls 'charm'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I agree – and he used another word 'frisson' meaning a sudden, strong feeling of excitement,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: or fear.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: My biggest fear would be returning to my desk for 9.00!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But Alastair is right, there is an adventure to be had on your doorstep – that means

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: close to where you live.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But only a small adventure Rob!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Unlike an adventure round the circumference of the Earth.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yes, that was my question earlier: how far it is around the world measured at the equator

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: – in other worlds the circumference?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It is approximately…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I said c) 50,000 km.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Sorry, Neil – too far.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The Earth's circumference has been calculated to be 40,075km.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: To travel that distance would be a major adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, I think we should remind ourselves of the some of the words and phrases we've discussed

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: today – starting with wanderlust – a strong desire to travel.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Rob has wanderlust, he's never at home!"

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's because I have a sense of adventure.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's the feeling of doing a new, exciting and sometimes dangerous activity.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Neil has no sense of adventure because he likes his holidays to be planned out with

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: no surprises!"

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's a little unfair Rob – I just like to be 'holiday happy' – that's a term I've

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: just coined, which means used a word or phrase that no one has used before.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You can also say 'to coin a phrase' after using an expression that is well known and

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: possibly used too much.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Next we heard hunch – that's an idea you have based on feelings but there's no proof.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "I have a hunch Neil wants to go to the pub – he's packing his bag!"

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Your hunch is correct Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But not before we recap our next word charm – that's part of the pleasure or enjoyment

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: of something.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Part of the charm of going to the seaside is eating ice cream and walking down the pier."

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And finally we heard on your doorstep - that means close to where you live.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "There's a pub right on your doorstep, so why don't you make the most of it!"

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I intend to Rob but first let me to remind you that you can learn English with us at

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: bbclearningenglish.com.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's it for today's 6 Minute English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We hope you enjoyed it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye for now.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: This is 6 Minute English, and I'm Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I'm Sam.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now, Sam, we’re going to be talking about tattoos.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Are you a fan?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Of tattoos?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, I don’t have one, but they can be quite impressive works of art.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, I’m not that keen on tattoos – I mean, who wants things drawn on their body?!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It sounds like you need some convincing, Rob!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Maybe our discussion today will change your mind.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Maybe.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But as you’re a fan of them, here’s a question for you to answer.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: According to the Guinness World Records, the record for the most tattooed person in the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: world goes to Lucky Diamond Rich from New Zealand.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Do you know how much of his body is covered by tattoos?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Is it…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Or

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What do you think, Sam?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, it’s got to be 100% if he is the most tattooed man, surely?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Not necessarily, but, we’ll see if you’re right at the end of the programme.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now let’s talk more about tattoos.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I know many people have them.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Sometimes it’s a picture of an animal, like a small gecko, sometimes it’s words like

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: ‘I love you’ or the name of a loved one.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And then there are the huge designs spread across someone’s back, chest or arm - like

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: footballer David Beckham has.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, he’s no stranger to a tattoo parlour.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A parlour is the name of the shop where a tattoo artist draws a tattoo on you with ink

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and a needle.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Needles!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Ouch!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, you need some convincing, so let’s hear from Lucie Parfitt, YouTuber and tattoo fan.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Here she is speaking on the BBC’s Smart Consumer podcast…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m quite a creative person and ever since I first discovered tattoos, I thought it was

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a really cool way of expressing yourself.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m quite a visual person as well, so for me it really, like, just looked really cool

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and it made me think more about my own, like, personality and how I could express that in

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: creative ways.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Right, so, Lucie describes herself as a creative person.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: When you’re creative you imaginative and like to experiment with new ideas.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yes, Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And tattoos are a good way to be creative – trying out different designs and colours

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: - it’s a good way to express yourself.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Here, to express yourself means 'to show how you feel in a particular way'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, so some people express themselves through singing or wearing particular clothing, but

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: here she’s expressing herself through the images on her skin.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But what happens if you want change what you want to express?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, then it’s time for a new tattoo!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, well I know that the tattoo industry is big business now – which means it's 'popular

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and making lots of money'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’ve heard that one in five people now have a tattoo.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Not you yet, Rob!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But it has certainly become a trend in recent years and it’s something tattoo artist Lee

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Clements has noticed.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Also speaking on the BBC’s Smart Consumer podcast, he explains why he thinks that is….

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The thing for me that has obviously changed massively over the last, possibly, ten years

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: is you see a lot of celebrities getting tattooed.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: With that comes the fact that you’re going to get people who want to copy them or it

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: becomes almost like a fashion thing, so we do see certain tattoos, sort of , becoming

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a trend and… yeah, so I guess it kind of dilutes that value a little bit, yeah.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Ah so it’s celebrities – famous, well-known people from TV, film and fashion – that

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: have possibly driven the trend.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: People want to copy them – or it’s what he says is ‘a fashion thing’, so you have

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a tattoo because it’s fashionable, which means it’s 'popular at a particular time'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And one of the downsides – the negative things – about just having one to be fashionable

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: is it dilutes the individuality of having one.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Dilute means to 'make something less strong or less valuable'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, I’m not going to get one anytime soon – except maybe a big six on my arm to remind

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: me that we only have 6 minutes for this programme so I’d better reveal the answer to the question

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I asked you earlier.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: According to Guinness World Records, the record for the most tattooed person in the world

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: goes to Lucky Diamond Rich from New Zealand.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Did you know how much of his body is covered by tattoos?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I said 100%.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well done, Sam.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That is correct.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: He has held the certified record since 2006 of being 100% tattooed.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: This includes tattoos inside his eyelids, mouth and ears.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Wow!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I wonder who gets to see those!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK well, now it’s time to recap the vocabulary we’ve discussed today starting with a parlour.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That’s the name for a shop or room where certain businesses carry out their trade – such

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: as a tattoo parlour, a massage parlour or an ice cream parlour.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A creative person is someone who uses imagination and experiments with new ideas.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And when you express yourself, it means you 'show outwardly how you feel and what you’re

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: thinking'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If something is big business it is an activity that is currently popular and making lots

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: of money.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And something that is fashionable is popular.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And when something becomes popular it can dilute its value or uniqueness – so it becomes

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: less strong or less valuable.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, thank you, Sam.

text: That’s all for now but there’s plenty more on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.

text: Goodbye for now!
