name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello and welcome to 6 Minute English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I'm Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hi!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I'm Catherine.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now, Catherine, when was the last time you went for a walk in the country for fun, for

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: exercise or relaxation?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: People do that?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, believe it or not, they do.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Interesting, people are strange.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, it sounds like you should pay close attention to today's programme because it's

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: all about how fewer and fewer people are venturing out into the country.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, I wonder if that word is part of the problem.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: To venture out somewhere suggests that it's a big challenge, or even a risky activity.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I don't think a walk in the country is a particularly dangerous activity, even in bad weather.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's not one of the reasons people gave in a recent survey for why they don't do it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In fact, one of the biggest reasons people gave was that it wouldn't look good on their

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: social media.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, of course, why would you go for a walk in the rain in the country if you couldn't

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: get good snaps for your social media account?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Interesting you should say that because it's the topic of this week's quiz question.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In the survey, what percentage of people gave the poor social media photo opportunity as

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: their reason for not wanting to venture out into the countryside?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Was it: a) around 10%,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: b) around 30% or c) around 50%?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What do you think?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: To be honest, I don't think that would be a good excuse at all, so I'm going to say

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: it's just 10%.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Listen out for the answer at the end of the programme.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Annabel Shackleton is from an organisation called Leaf – Linking Environment and Farming.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: They want to encourage more people to visit the countryside.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: She recently appeared on the BBC's Farming Today radio programme.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: She gave her response to the survey we mentioned which revealed that many of us prefer to stay

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: indoors.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What does she say a quarter of people in the survey know and believe?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I can’t believe that 4 in 10 millennials think they should spend more time in the countryside

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and a quarter of them know and believe that it's much better and easier to relax in the

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: countryside but they’re just not going out.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's phenomenal.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: She was talking about a group in the survey which she called millennials.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: This term refers to people who are young adults now, people who were born in the 1980s and

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Are you a millennial, Neil?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: No, I'm actually Generation X, the age group before millennials.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We were born in the 1960s, 70s and early 80s.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Shackleton said that a quarter of millennials know and believe that it's better and easier

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: to relax in the country, but they just don’t go.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: She thought it was phenomenal.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now this adjective means that something is incredible, unbelievable.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's often used for something that is positive, something that is very impressive or amazing.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In this case though she is using it to say how shocked and surprised she is that people

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: know going out in the country is good and a great way to relax but they still don't

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: do it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So what explanation does she have for this phenomenal behaviour.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Here's Annabel Shackleton again.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There are just so many other distractions and it's just so easy for people to stay indoors.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You know and they're using excuses like they haven't got the right clothing, it's not instagramable,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: would you believe it?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And yes, it's a shame.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: She said that there are many other distractions.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A distraction is something that takes your attention away from doing something.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Usually, we think of a distraction as something that delays us from doing something more important.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: These days we have a lot of distractions or things that offer us easy entertainment.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So it's very easy to come up with an excuse for not taking the time to go outside.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Another very good excuse of course is the weather.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's not a lot of fun to go out if it's cold and pouring with rain.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, a very wise person once said that there is no such thing as the wrong weather, just

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: the wrong clothing!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: True, Neil, but you have to have the right clothing in the first place and if the weather

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: is terrible you might not be able to get good pictures for your Instagram account.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: They might not be instagramable.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now you're not going to find that word in the dictionary, but you probably know that

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: the suffix able means 'possible'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So put able on the end of Instagram and you get instagramable.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And that brings us neatly back to our question.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What percentage of people in the survey said that they wouldn't go out in the country because

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: they wouldn't get good pictures for social media?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Was it around 10%, 30% or 50%.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What did you say, Catherine?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I said 10.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And the answer was about 30%!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What is the world coming to?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I don’t know what the world is coming to, but we are coming to the end of the programme,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: so time to review today's vocabulary.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We started off with to venture out somewhere, which simply means to go out somewhere, but

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: usually when the conditions are bad, for example – it was pouring with rain but I still decided

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: to venture out to the shops.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We heard about millennials and Generation X. Different age groups, millennials are those

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: who became adults in the early 21st century, and Generation X are from the previous generation,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: who became adults in the 1980s and 1990s.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Something phenomenal is amazing, surprising and unbelievable.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And then we had distractions for activities that prevent us from doing more important

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: things.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And one of the biggest distractions is social media.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Put the suffix able onto the end of the name of a social media platform and you create

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a word that describes something that is suitable for posting, so instagramable.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: BBCLearningEnglish is certainly instagramable, facebookable, tweetable and youtubeable.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You can find us on all those platforms as well as on our website.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So do check us out there before joining us again for more 6 Minute English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Goodbye.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Goodbye!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Welcome to 6 Minute English, the programme where we explore an interesting topic and

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: bring you some useful items vocabulary.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I'm Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I'm Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now Neil, I know you're a keen swimmer.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I am.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I try to get to the pool once a week and do a few lengths, yes.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: That's good to hear because swimming is one of the best sports for keeping fit.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's an aerobic exercise – aerobic means a very active type of exercise that makes

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: your heart and lungs stronger.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The opposite of this is anaerobic – and for my question today Neil, I wonder if you

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: know which of these activities is an example of anaerobic exercise?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a) weightlifting

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: b) kickboxing

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: c) dancing

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I don't have a clue but I'll pick my favourite sport – a) weightlifting.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Is that really your favourite sport?!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Anyway, we'll find out the answer at the end of the programme.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So what about you Rob – do you visit the swimming pool very often?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Only to use the cafe!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I don't like anything aquatic – I mean connected to water.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I just don't like getting wet - and swimming up and down a pool is just boring!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well there are alternatives to plain swimming.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There's synchronised swimming…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Synchronised – that's moving together at the same time or speed as someone else.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Like dancing in water I suppose?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hmm, I'm not a good dancer either.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: How about the new craze of 'mermaiding' which is making a splash at the moment – in other

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: words becoming very popular.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The idea originated in America but is now popular in the UK and Europe.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Tell me more!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Let's hear from an expert – Emma Longden, who's founder of Fin2Fit – which runs classes,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: teaching the skills of swimming safely like a mermaid…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Mermaiding is putting a monofin on your feet.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Putting a beautiful tail on and getting in the water and swimming like a mermaid.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, so I would need to wear a monofin – the prefix 'mono' means 'only one or single' – so

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a single fin –that's like a mermaid's tail - then I just get in the water and swim like

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a mermaid – I'm not so sure about that Neil – I don't really know how mermaids swim!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There's more to it than that Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's actually good for your fitness as Emma can explain…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It gives children's confidence in water a boost, it improves their water strength, it

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: gives you an entire body workout.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It works your cardiovascular system, it works your legs, your core – it improves the children's

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: swimming technique, flexibility, balance, co-ordination – you get the reward, you

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: get the social aspect – and alongside all of that, they're learning vital life skills

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: along the way.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So there are many benefits to mermaiding Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Improving confidence, strength, technique and it's good for your cardiovascular system

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: – cardiovascular relates to your heart and blood vessels.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I like the sound of the social aspect – and by that Emma means being with other people

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and having fun.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's an activity that's sociable.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And it teaches life skills – useful skills that help you deal with everyday challenges.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well that's great for kids – and that's the problem.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What's that?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Mermaiding is for kids – so I can't get involved – even if I wanted to… can I?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You can Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: According to Emma, it's growing in popularity with adults too – any excuse to live out

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: your fantasies hey!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There are so many adults that actually kind of want to live out their childhood dreams

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: that they wanted to be a mermaid when they were children and they didn't get the opportunity

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and now it's here and now it's available and...

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So yes, we do a lot of adult classes as well.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There you go Rob – living out your childhood dreams – that doing things you wanted to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: do when you were a child.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Like being a mermaid!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Sorry Neil, that wasn't a dream for me – although I did dream of swimming like a shark once!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Anyway, mermaiding is a good form of aerobic exercise – but earlier I asked you what

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: an example of anaerobic exercise is.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Is it…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a) weightlifting

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: b) kickboxing

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: c) dancing

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I said weightlifting.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Was I right?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You were Neil, well done.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Any exercise that consists of short exertion, high-intensity movement is an anaerobic exercise

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: – such as weight lifting, sprinting and jumping.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I won't go into scientific detail – but aerobics exercise is done over a longer period

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: of time and strengthens the heart and lungs, thereby improving the body's utilisation of

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: oxygen.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Thanks for that Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now I think we should sprint through our recap of some of the words we've talked about today

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: – starting with 'aerobic', which you just explained.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Mermaiding is a good aerobic workout."

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Assuming you don't mind dressing up!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Next we had 'aquatic' which refers to something connected with water.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Synchronised swimming is an example of an aquatic sport."

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Ah, you slipped in another of our words there – 'synchronised' – which means 'moving

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: together at the same time or speed as someone or something else'.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "We synchronised our watches so that we all arrived at the same time."

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Good idea – you're always late Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Then we mentioned 'mono' which means 'one' or 'single' and is used as a prefix on words

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: such as 'monochrome' – one colour – or 'monorail' – a train running on a single

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: track.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Then we heard the word 'cardiovascular' - a word that relates to the effect on your heart

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and lungs.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Experts say those who quit smoking could also quickly reduce their risk of cardiovascular

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: disease."

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Finally, we also mentioned 'social' – this adjective relates to activities that you do

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: with other people and are usually fun.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: "Now I live in London, I have a great social life."

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well you never invite me out Rob!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Anyway, that's it for this edition of 6 Minute English.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Before you rush off to fulfil your dream of being a mermaid, don't forget to visit our

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and YouTube pages, and of course our website!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yes and that's at bbclearningenglish.com.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye for now.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Goodbye

text: Goodbye.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Welcome to 6 Minute English, where we introduce a colourful topic and six suitable items of

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: vocabulary.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m Tim…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I’m Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Why are you wearing a policeman’s hat, Tim?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: To get me in the mood for our topic today – uniforms!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, the hat certainly suits you!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And if something suits you it looks good on you!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, thanks, Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And funnily enough, I have a question for you on the subject of police hats!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In the 19th century, police officers' top hats could be used…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a) to stand on, b) as a weapon or

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: c) to protect their heads from the sun?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, they're kind of pointy so I’m going to say as a weapon.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Let’s consider what the point of a uniform is.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Why do some jobs have them while others don’t?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well – The police, and other emergency services, like the fire brigade, and ambulance service

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: – they need practical clothes to help them do their job.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: People need to recognize them too, don’t they?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yeah, that’s right.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A uniform makes people stand out from crowd.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If something stands out it’s noticeable or easy to see.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But uniform also allows you to fit in – it shows you belong to a particular group or

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: organization – and people often enjoy that sense of community at work.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Do you think we should get some 6 Minute English T-shirts made, Neil?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Well, we share a sense of community without team T-shirts, Tim.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Let’s listen to cultural historian, Joe Moran, talking about why wearing a uniform

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: can also allow you to behave differently to the way you normally behave.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It’s a role and a genre that you adopt and it’s kind of – it’s something that’s

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: not quite you.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It’s kind of a persona that you can put on.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In Germany they call it ‘maskenfreiheit’, which is the freedom conferred by masks.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There’s something about taking on what is very clearly a persona or professional role,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: that can be liberating, I think.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So when you put on a uniform you are adopting a role or genre.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Genre means a particular style.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And a persona is a character you present to the outside world – as opposed to the person

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: you feel like inside.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Joe Moran compares putting on a persona to putting on a mask.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And he says this can be very liberating.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But do you really think putting on a uniform liberates – or frees – us from the person

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: we really are?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Maybe.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If you’re shy, for example, a uniform might feel liberating because it allows you to behave

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: more confidently.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So, if you could choose a uniform and a new persona, what would it be, Tim?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hmm.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: An airline pilot, I think.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’d look great in a blazer with brass buttons – and with the cap and mirror sunglasses.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello, this is your captain speaking.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We’ll shortly be arriving at LAX airport in sunny Los Angeles.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Local time is 12.55 and it’s hot hot hot outside, so I hope you’ve packed plenty

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: of sun cream.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK Tim, stop, stop, stop, stop, stop!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I can see you’d love being a pilot – or at least you’d love talking to your passengers!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What about you, Neil?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What would you like to try on for size?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A surgeon’s scrubs?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A nun’s habit?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: To try something on for size means to decide whether it’s what you want or not.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: No Tim…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’d go for a chef’s apron, checked trousers, a tall hat.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I think the uniform would suit you, but are you good at cooking, Neil?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m an excellent cook.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now, I think we should have the answer to today’s quiz question, Tim.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yes, I asked what a police officer’s hat could be used for in the 19th century.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I said as a weapon.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Wrong, I’m afraid.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: From 1829 to 1839, Metropolitan Police officers wore a cane-reinforced top hat, which could

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: be used as a step to climb or see over walls.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I wonder if modern police hats are strong enough to stand on?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: We’ll try yours later and find out.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But now let’s go over the other key words we learned today.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If something ‘suits you’, it looks good on you.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: For example, “Does this pilot’s uniform suit me, Neil?”

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It suits you down to the ground, Tim!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And that means it suits you very well!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Number two – If something ‘stands out’, it’s noticeable or easy to see.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: “My colourful suit really stood out at the party.”

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: In a good way, I hope!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, next item – ‘to fit in’ – means you belong to a particular group and are accepted

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: by them.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: “I never fitted in with the cool kids at school.”

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m sorry to hear that, Tim!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Maybe you weren’t wearing the right uniform?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Number four is ‘persona’ – the character you present to the outside world – as opposed

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: to the person you feel like inside.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: “My work persona is confident and chatty but I’m actually rather shy.”

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I’m learning a lot about you today, Tim!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: They’re just examples, Neil.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I don’t have a work persona – that’s the nice thing about our job – there’s

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: no need to put on masks or personas.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Just the occasional hat…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Indeed.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And a very nice hat this is too – I think I’ll keep it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now, let’s finish the vocabulary!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Number five – ‘liberating’ means feeling you can behave however you like.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: For example, “Talking openly about your problems can be very liberating.”

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And finally, ‘to try something on for size’ means to test something to decide whether

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: you want it or not.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Our listeners can try these new vocabulary items on for size and decide whether they’ll

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: be useful or not!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And if not, then please let us know by visiting our Twitter, Facebook and YouTube pages and

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: telling us what you think!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Goodbye!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Hello and welcome to Six Minute English!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I'm Catherine.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I'm Rob – and today we bring you a techy topic along with six up-to-date vocabulary

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: items.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And today's techy topic is smartphones.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So Rob, can you tell me which age group have been buying smartphones at the fastest rate

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: over the last five years here in the UK?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Is it… a) 15-35 year olds,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: b) 35-55 year olds or c) 55-75 year olds?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's got to be the youngsters.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's got to be the 15-35 year olds.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Oh well we'll see whether you got that right or wrong later on in the show.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Now Rob, a question: how old is your smartphone?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK mine, I bought it a couple of years ago.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And are you happy with it?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Yes, I am.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It works just fine – it does everything I need it to do.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So you're not worried about not having the latest model?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Not at all.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: My phone works really well – it has all the functionality I need.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And I'm not convinced that the latest model offers any more than the one I've got, to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: be honest.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Functionality refers to the range of functions a computer or other electronic device can

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: perform.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So, let's listen now to Andrew Orlowski, from the tech news website The Register.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: He explains why people are holding onto their phones longer – instead of rushing out to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: buy the latest model of phone.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What's happened is that prices have gone up at the high end.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And it's kind of a cycle where people hang onto their phones for longer, therefore manufacturers

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: charge more.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Then people hang onto them longer to justify that higher purchase.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So big brand names like iPhone and Samsung make phones at the high end of the market

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: – meaning the expensive ones.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So once people have bought a handset, they hang on to it!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: If you hang onto something, you keep it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I've been hanging onto my phone for a couple of years – and am hoping I won't need to

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: change it for another year or so, at least.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But what happens is, if people aren't replacing their phones, the phone manufacturers don't

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: make a big enough profit.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So they start charging more…

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: … and this, in turn, makes people hang onto their phones even longer!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So that's why Andrew Orlowski calls it a cycle – that's where one event leads to another,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: and then often repeats itself.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: So where will the cycle end?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Good question!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Let's listen to Andrew again, talking about where he thinks the smartphone market is heading.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I think it's a very mature market now.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And you have to compare, say, a £900 Galaxy Note or a £1000 iPhone with a spectacular

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: TV you can… a 49 inch TV you can get for £450.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It no longer has that kind of must-have lustre that it might have had 4 or 5 years ago.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What does 'mature' mean, Rob?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Mature means fully-grown – we're mature adults for example, Catherine!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And in a business context, a mature market is where supply is equal to demand.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And if something has 'must-have lustre'?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: What's that?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A must-have item is something you feel you must have.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And lustre means shine.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: I love shiny new things, especially when it's a piece of new tech.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: But £1000 is a lot of money for a phone.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: A spectacular 49-inch TV for only £450 sounds like a bargain though!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: My TV only has a 30-inch screen.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Stop there, Catherine!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: It's time for the answer to today's question.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK: Which age group have been buying smartphones at the fastest rate over the last five years

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: here in the UK?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Is it… a) 15-35-year-olds, b) 35-55-year-olds, or c) 55-75-year-olds?

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Rob I said 15-35-year-olds.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And you were wrong, I'm afraid, Rob!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The answer is 55-75 year olds!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Although research also highlighted that this age group tended to use their smartphones

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: less than younger people.The study was based on a sample of 1,163 people questioned between

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: May and June in 2017.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Interesting.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK, I think it's time we looked back at the words we learned today.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Our first word is 'functionality' – which refers to the range of functions a computer

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: of other electronic device can perform.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: 'These two computers are similar in terms of both their price and functionality.'

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Good example Catherine.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Number two – if you hang on to something, you keep it.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: For example, 'You should hang onto your old TV, Catherine.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: There's nothing wrong with a 30 inch screen!'

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Thanks for the advice, Rob.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And our next word is 'cycle' – that's where one event leads to another, and then often

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: repeats itself.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: For example, 'I'm in a bad cycle of going to bed late, then oversleeping in the morning.'

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You need to sort yourself out, Catherine!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You're spending too much time on social media – and all that blue-screen time makes it

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: very hard to fall asleep.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: The last thing you need is a bigger TV!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: You're probably right.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK – the adjective 'mature' means fully grown or fully developed.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Here's an example of the verb form– 'My investments have matured and they're worth

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: a lot of money now!'

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Right moving on, a 'must-have item' is something you feel you must have!

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: For example, 'Check out the latest must-have tech bargains on our website!'

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: And finally, 'lustre' – which means shine.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: For example, 'I polished my brass doorknob until it shone with a pleasing lustre.'

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: OK before Rob heads off to polish his doorknob, and I nip out to buy a new big-screen TV,

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: please remember to check out our Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube pages.

name: BBC 6 Minute English: 1-Hour Lifestyle Mega-Class
text: Bye!
